title: The Sharpest Lives
overview: In the post digital year of 2095, Reed Rickman the son of the boxer Richard Rickman aka the Fabulous Killjoy attempts to continue his fathers legacy in the world of Robot fighting. After years of continual loses, Reed is finally given the opportunity to fight against the world champion Andrew Darren aka the GTX-1 but this only further complicates his fragile relationship with his girlfriend Ashely.
